summary: All 48 source files matched their recorded sizes and SHA-256 hashes. I reproduced all 11 computed claims. Figure 6 reports 404 WT hypothalamic DEGs (96 up, 308 down). The registered seven-vehicle, eight-treated analysis has 2,985 genes at raw P < 0.05 and zero after BH adjustment. The corrected proposal distinguishes the caption’s six mice per group from verified sample membership and records the broader no-treatment-effect statement in the Discussion. The proposal passed validation. [Figure 6](https://pmc-oa-opendata.s3.amazonaws.com/PMC12270663.1/gr6.jpg) · [Discussion](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12270663/#sec4)
openIssues: The closure remains needs_author_contact. The final WT sample IDs, assignment of the two ARC exclusions, Figure 6 calling rule and tested-gene export are needed to assess gene-level concordance.
The authors have not identified which analysis supports the Discussion’s broader treatment-effect statement.
